name: Kupar Lingo
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Kupar Lingo builds a programme of collective recognition through public craft teaching and cultural reform. Apprenticeship and shared technical standards give communities a way to act together as industrial patronage expands. The University register proposes a connection to Formation of the Furnace Confederacy, Dispute over Patent Claims on Charcoal Measures and Plateau Charter Crisis. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
